description: Weekly dependency updates. Base UI and each library a component wraps (docs/design.md, 'Foundations') get a pull request of their own, so a primitive bump is reviewed alone against the browser suite; dev tooling is grouped. A held version (allowedVersions, or a disabled update) must carry a description with a link to the issue or pull request that explains it. minimumReleaseAge is three days because pnpm-workspace.yaml keeps versions published in the last day out of an install, so a pull request for a newer one could not install.

packageRules.description: Base UI is the primitive layer: reviewed alone, against the part tests and page specs in every engine.
Wrapped libraries are pinned exactly (docs/design.md, 'Foundations'), each in a pull request of its own.
Build, test, lint and site tooling move together.
Workflow actions stay pinned to a full commit SHA with the version in a comment.
